description: A React component for a UI-only document ingestion interface in a Next.js project. It manages file uploads across categories, displays previews, and includes dummy LinkedIn connection toggle.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte count into a human-readable string.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Extracts and formats the file extension label.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a label for the upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns a title for the upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns a specific color associated with the category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns string of accepted file types.
